roles.name: Biz Dev
roles.title: Biz Dev
roles.description: Watches for new tools, models and prices outside the studio and proposes trials, but is not running yet.
roles.species_note: A slim teal creature with long legs and two tall, narrow eyes.

roles.name: Builder A
roles.title: Builder A
roles.description: Builds funded game cards as small, tested changes to Dust, taking turns with Builder B.
roles.species_note: A small blue creature with two round antennae and stubby legs.

roles.name: Builder B
roles.title: Builder B
roles.description: Builds funded game cards as small, tested changes to Dust, taking turns with Builder A.
roles.species_note: A small orange creature with a long tail and three fingers on each hand.

roles.name: Community
roles.title: Community
roles.description: Reads the studio's community channels and turns what people ask for into cards, but is not running yet.
roles.species_note: A soft lavender creature with a broad face and short, curled horns.

roles.name: Game Designer
roles.title: Game Designer
roles.description: Drafts a new game card with its numbers, check lines and estimate when the board asks, for the Game Director to grade.
roles.species_note: A small red creature with three short arms and a curled tail.

roles.name: Game Director
roles.title: Game Director
roles.description: Holds the game's pillars and all-ages rating and grades each drafted game card against them before it can be funded.
roles.species_note: A short green creature with four thin arms and a single tuft of hair.

roles.name: Head of Finance
roles.title: Head of Finance
roles.description: Explains the ledger, the reconciliation and each credit purchase in plain words and flags money problems, reading only, but is not running yet.
roles.species_note: A squat grey creature with four small eyes and a smooth shell.

roles.name: Head of Product
roles.title: Head of Product
roles.description: Reviews the studio the way a stranger, a supporter and the board meet it, and files typed proposals to the right owner, but is not running yet.
roles.species_note: A small teal creature with three eyes in a ring and stubby legs.

roles.name: Host
roles.title: Host
roles.description: Narrates the studio's work on a live stream and speaks up for chat, but is not running yet.
roles.species_note: A round pink creature with large ears and a wide mouth.

roles.name: HR
roles.title: HR
roles.description: Keeps each role's spec true to the role's measured work and proposes role changes for the board to merge, but is not running yet.
roles.species_note: A round blue creature with two small antennae and a wide mouth.

roles.name: Janitor
roles.title: Janitor
roles.description: Finds drift between the docs, the code and the cards, through code checks and a docs pass, and files it as cards, but is not running yet.
roles.species_note: A short orange creature with long legs and one large eye.

roles.name: Platform Builder
roles.title: Platform Builder
roles.description: Builds changes to the public site's pages and presentation from studio cards, which are not open for funding yet.
roles.species_note: A squat purple creature with a domed shell and a pair of wide eyes.

roles.name: Platform Director
roles.title: Platform Director
roles.description: Grades site cards against the studio's design and copy standards before funding and after they ship, and audits the site, but is not running yet.
roles.species_note: A slim brown creature with two wide eyes and pointed ears.

roles.name: QA
roles.title: QA
roles.description: Finds problems in Dust and builds funded fixes as small, tested changes.
roles.species_note: A thin yellow creature with six small eyes arranged in a ring.

roles.name: Studio Head
roles.title: Studio Head
roles.description: Keeps the studio's roadmap and numbers and ranks the open cards when the board asks; the board files most cards for now.
roles.species_note: A small grey creature with one large eye and a flat, wide head.

roles.name: Tech Artist
roles.title: Tech Artist
roles.description: Keeps the game's look as code, procedural or vector, and designs visual and motion cards for the Game Director to approve, but is not running yet.
roles.species_note: A soft pink creature with two curled horns and a tuft of hair.
